A bright loft flat by the park

Flat 4, 14 Linden Court, Clifton, Bristol BS8

£435,000Guide price, freehold share
2bedrooms
1bathroom
78 m²840 sq ft
Cenergy rating
£98service charge a month

About this home

This top-floor flat sits in a Victorian house turned into four homes. Big sash windows face south over the park, so the living room gets sun from late morning until evening.

The open-plan kitchen and living room has oak floors and a working fireplace. Both bedrooms are doubles, and the second one works well as a home office. The owners replaced the kitchen and bathroom in 2024.

  • Top floor, park views
  • Kitchen and bathroom new in 2024
  • Working fireplace
  • Oak floors throughout
  • Shared garden with bike store
  • Residents' parking permit
  • Long lease, 961 years left
  • No onward chain

Floor plan

Tap a room on the plan or in the list to see its size and notes.

    The area

    A quiet street five minutes' walk from shops, cafés and the suspension bridge.

    • 2 minwalk to the park
    • 6 minwalk to the high street
    • 12 minbus to the city centre
    • 0.4 mito the nearest primary school

    Book a viewing

    Viewings take about 20 minutes. Open house this Saturday, or pick a weekday time.
